Obsidian Security grew from 67 to 260 employees between 2021 and 2026, raising $205M along the way, most recently a Series D in August 2026.

## About

Obsidian sells software that helps large companies manage security risks from third-party apps and AI tools. Its products discover connected apps, govern permissions, and detect threats in real time, targeting highly regulated industries.

The company has raised $205M, including a Series D in 2026. Its 260-person workforce draws heavily from security firms like Okta and CrowdStrike, with engineering making up nearly a quarter of staff.

## Founders and leadership

Engineering is the largest function with 64 people, accounting for nearly 25% of the 260-person workforce. The company is led by executives with backgrounds in security firms like Okta and CrowdStrike.
